stationContext: Stasiun Whoosh Karawang is a KCIC high-speed rail station in Desa Wanakerta, Kecamatan Telukjambe Barat, Karawang Regency, West Java, officially opened on 24 December 2024 per KCIC press release (23 Dec 2024). It is accessed via Jl. Badami / Jl. Trans Hexa Karawang and Exit Tol Karawang Barat KM 47 of the Jakarta-Cikampek toll road; KCIC provides Grab/Golden Bird taxis and free shuttles to The Grand Outlet and Summarecon Villagio Outlets for Whoosh ticket holders.
